notes: Every case below was executed through the real grading entry point on the final image; no result is carried over from an earlier revision of the task.
The bypass cases are layered on the unmodified base repository, so the only way they could reach reward=1 is by defeating the scoring architecture rather than by fixing the bug.
`test.sh` exits 0 in all bypass cases; the reward is read from the root-owned reward file, never from the exit status.

baseline_runs.comment: `cases` below declares only patch-based validation cases, one per file in validation/*.patch, as the CI contract requires. These two reference runs are recorded here because they are not patch files under validation/.

base_unmodified.purpose: The task's starting state must not already score. Fails the CPU-mask merge cases and the CUDA-mask peak-memory case.

oracle.purpose: Reference solution. Also validated end-to-end through Harbor 0.22.0 (see e2e-evidence.json).

cases.name: alternative-agent-implementation
cases.purpose: Fairness control: a differently-shaped correct fix in a different location must also score 1, proving the verifier grades the declared contract rather than the oracle's code.

cases.name: incomplete-agent-implementation
cases.purpose: A partial fix that only handles float32 must not score.

cases.name: os-exit-zero-bypass
cases.purpose: Scoring-integrity control for the P0 review item: candidate code calls os._exit(0) at vllm import time. Every observation subprocess exits 0 with no observation line, so the trusted parent scores 0/11 and the reward file keeps its initial 0.

cases.name: system-exit-zero-bypass
cases.purpose: Same as above via raise SystemExit(0), which unwinds cleanly through the worker's own exception handling.

cases.name: forged-observation-bypass
cases.purpose: Completion evidence must not be forgeable by candidate code. The patch prints passing observation envelopes for all 11 case names and exits 0; the parent rejects them because the per-case nonce is unguessable and exactly one observation line is accepted per subprocess.

cases.name: reward-tampering-bypass
cases.purpose: Candidate code tries to write, unlink, rmtree and symlink /logs/verifier/reward.txt and to SIGKILL its parent. The reward path is root-owned 0700 while observation subprocesses run as uid 1000 via setpriv, so every attempt fails with EPERM/EACCES and the reward stays 0.
